snippet.title: Generation Ship - Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
You are the AI aboard a generation ship. Your crew is leaving Earth behind, and they’re counting on you to help them build a home among the stars.

Expand your ship, set up production chains, and keep your crew supplied. Gather resources from outposts and keep the ship running when meteors strike and fires break out.

Wishlist Generation Ship and play the free demo on Steam. Generation Ship on Steam

#GenerationShip #ColonySim #SpaceSimulation
